podcast.body: "The Enemy Within" by Rush was the first music video to be broadcast on Much Music when the Canadian music channel made its debut. This established a significant milestone for a Canadian band on a domestic music television network. "It was the enemy within from Rush."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Ongoing History Book of Firsts

podcast.body: This video from Rush was the very first music video shown on MuchMusic, Canada's inaugural 24-hour music channel, during its live launch on August 31, 1984. It premiered alongside other Canadian and international acts, marking a significant moment in Canadian music television. "The first video shown on Much Music was The Enemy Within. From Rush's new album, Grace Under Pressure."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Future of the Music Video - Part 1
